real guideline.

A. Overview

A.1 Purpose

This sample guideline sets expectations for managing model risk across an enterprise.

A.2 Scope

The sample guideline applies to all models with non-negligible risk, including AI and machine learning models and models sourced from third parties.

C. Risk assessment

C.2 Model risk rating

Each model is assigned a risk rating that considers both quantitative and qualitative factors, and the rating sets the intensity of validation and monitoring.
